Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the lineage by identifying Albert I (the great-grandfather) as the paternal grandfather, despite WebSurfer’s result showing that John II’s father was Albert II. This generational miscount (confusing grandfather with great-grandfather) led to the wrong conclusion and subsequent redundant verification focused on Albert I rather than the correct grandfather, Albert II.
